references.text: The same introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, a common introduction to divine commands in the books of Moses.
The opening of Leviticus uses the same wording when the Lord calls to Moses and gives him instructions.
An identical introductory formula that introduces new laws concerning sin offerings.
The same formula is used to introduce instructions about sacrifices, closely contextually related to chapter 7.
The Lord speaks to Moses with the same introductory expression, this time regarding the consecration of Aaron and his sons.
Numbers opens with a similar formulation where the Lord speaks to Moses.
The same standardized introduction to divine revelation and legislation.
